Planning Document: docs/dcps/INNERWEST/Marrickville/Marrickville DCP 2011 - 2 18 Landscaping and Open Spaces.pdf

Clause 2.18 - other (development_control): Any new development must  preserve and protect any existing trees on site.

Clause O4 - other (environmental_protection): To minimise the extent of hard paved areas and facilitate rainwater infiltration.

Clause O9 - other (development_control): To ensure industrial sites have adequate landscape d areas to present a softer and more interesting street presentation and to facilitate rainwater infiltration.

Clause O10 - other (land_use_zoning): To create a vegetated buffer between residential and industrial  uses .

Clause O11 - other (environmental_protection): To encourage green corridors and to require the retention of indigenous vegetation –  and, in the case of new plantings, to encourage planting locally indigenous species.

Clause O12 - other (development_control): To encourage green roofs and green walls particularl y for large scale developments.
